segments.text:
V. 22.
And the beggar—Worn out with Hunger, and Pain, and Want of all Things, died; and was carried by angels (amazing Change of the Scene!) into Abraham's boſom—So the Jews ſtiled Paradiſe; the Place where the Souls of good Men remain from Death to the Reſurrection. The rich man alſo died, and was buried—Doubtleſs with Pomp enough, tho' we do not read of his lying in State: That ſtupid, ſenſeleſs, Pageantry, that ſhocking Inſult on a poor, putrifying Carcaſe, was reſerved for our enlightened Age!
